text:
maya: quick flag — during the RBAC rollup (viewer/editor/admin) I hit a weird edge: some pre-migration API keys still have a legacy role alias that grants project.edit despite UI gating. need triage, might be a migration hole. @ben can you look?

ben: looking now. saw one example in prod logs: `api_key=ak_01Fxx.. user=svc-ingest role=legacy_admin project=redwood-playground` — audit shows role alias used at token-unwrap time. :eyes:

ben: reproducer: local migration script recreated alias mapping but never cleaned `grants` table for api_keys. quick SQL to find candidates:```sql
SELECT id, name, role_alias FROM api_keys WHERE role_alias IS NOT NULL LIMIT 50;```

rachel: big question — if we clean aliases do we need to rewrap keys via KMS? KMS unwrap events are our only reliable evidence that a token was used. I noticed some unwrap events missing for the older keys — sec-bot flagged a gap.

sec-bot: ALERT: anomalous KMS unwrap pattern detected for 3 tokens between 2024-06-12T02:14Z and 2024-06-12T02:20Z. No corresponding RBAC-change audit recorded.

ben: ok, two-fold plan: 1) migration job to null out `role_alias` and delete implicit grants, 2) emit an audit log entry for each cleaned key so security has traceability. Proposed cleanup SQL:```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE grants g SET role = 'viewer'
FROM api_keys k
WHERE k.id = g.resource_id AND k.role_alias = 'legacy_admin';
UPDATE api_keys SET role_alias = NULL WHERE role_alias = 'legacy_admin';
-- emit audit rows in application layer
COMMIT;```

evan: add a feature flag roll: rollout to 5% orgs first, metric `rbac.migration.cleanup.count` and `rbac.migration.rollback.count`. Canary should include orgs with at least one API key and projects >1. Also need a fast rollback: restore role_alias from a snapshot table we create before changes.

rachel: also suggest we tie the cleanup to a KMS rewrap check: if a key hasn't been unwrapped since migration start, mark it for manual review rather than auto-modify. avoids breaking long-lived offline integrations.

maya: +1 on canary + manual review threshold. can we add a UI gating change to prevent the console from showing edit button if role_alias present and flagged for review? small patch to the permission check layer should do it.

ben: I'll draft the PR: will include DB migration, cleanup job, emitted audit events, and a feature-flagged rollout. tagging @rachel for the KMS audit format, @evan for metrics/rollout policy.

rachel: i'll write the audit schema: include fields `api_key_id, former_role_alias, changed_by, reason, kms_unwrap_seen` and a signed timestamp. will post snippet in PR comments.

evan: scheduler: plan run during off-peak (Sat 02:00 UTC), 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h if no alerts. rollback window 2h after each cohort.

maya: 👍 thanks. ordering: ben PR -> rachel audit schema PR -> evan rollout config -> canary. i'll own the incident channel and docs. :shipit:

sec-bot: NOTE: incident channel created #inc-2024-06-rbac-legacy-alias-cleanup by maya

maya: I'll follow up with a small postmortem template once done and add a checklist for on-call to verify KMS unwrap counts and console gating.
